document.original_text: Update to an existing initiative: Expand Mirket to 25 skills and make project memory reliable. The user expanded this initiative from source-candidate preparation to installing local Mirket 0.4.0 in the normal Codex and Claude environments, adopting matching live global instructions, and completing all 26 knowledge-page refreshes; both installations now exactly match the 76-file package with all25 native skills, with no commit, public release or website deployment. Current lifecycle ownership is Secure security/privacy, Migrate persistent state, Release versioned artifacts/distribution, Deploy environment rollout, and Operate health/recovery; Distill owns routine communication, Author owns durable documents/substantive copy/issues, settled ADRs go in docs/decisions while .work/decisions is private drafts, references use PascalCase including Routing.md and Memory.md, and existing execution authorization suffices for delegation without a separately approved written plan. The verified Codex0.167.0 hook-discovery defect required .codex-plugin/plugin.json alongside the Claude descriptor and removal of portable root plugin.json: normal installed Codex now discovers25skills/four trusted active hooks and actual fresh sessions passed startup/prompt guidance, dry-run allowance, absolute-target and staged-.work commit denials, neutral default Stop and exactly one opt-in review continuation; Claude startup/prompt hooks pass but model-driven verification requires login, and final page synthesis is being checked for semantic currency after consolidated corrections rather than treating timestamps as sufficient.

items.text: Fresh Codex sessions passed startup and prompt guidance, dry-run allowance, absolute-target denial, staged-.work commit denial, neutral default Stop, and exactly one opt-in review continuation. Claude startup and prompt hooks pass, but model-driven verification still requires login; final knowledge-page synthesis is being checked for semantic currency rather than relying on timestamps alone. | Where: Codex and Claude environments | These verification constraints define the current validation status and acceptance criteria.

items.text: A verified Codex 0.167.0 hook-discovery defect was resolved by adding .codex-plugin/plugin.json alongside the Claude descriptor and removing the portable root plugin.json. Normal installed Codex now discovers 25 skills and four trusted active hooks. | Where: Codex and Claude plugin environments | The change fixes hook discovery in the normal installed Codex environment.

items.text: Settled ADRs belong in docs/decisions, while .work/decisions is reserved for private drafts. References use PascalCase, including Routing.md and Memory.md, and existing execution authorization is sufficient for delegation without a separately approved written plan. | Where: docs/decisions and .work/decisions | These are established documentation, naming, and authorization conventions.

Lifecycle ownership is divided as follows: Secure handles security/privacy, Migrate handles persistent state, Release handles versioned artifacts/distribution, Deploy handles environment rollout, Operate handles health/recovery, Distill handles routine communication, and Author handles durable documents, substantive copy, and issues. | These ownership boundaries define how the initiative is maintained and operated.
